# jplot

Jplot tracks expvar-like (JSON) metrics and plot their evolution over time right into your iTerm2, Kitty terminal, or terminals with DRCS Sixel Graphics support.

![](doc/demo.gif)

Above capture is jplot monitoring a Go service's expvar:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars \
    memstats.HeapSys+memstats.HeapAlloc+memstats.HeapIdle+marker,counter:memstats.NumGC \
    counter:memstats.TotalAlloc \
    memstats.HeapObjects \
    memstats.StackSys+memstats.StackInuse
```

By default, jplot uses the full size of the terminal, but it is possible to limit the render to a few rows:

![](doc/rows.gif)

## Install

Using homebrew:

```
brew install rs/tap/jplot
```

This tool works with [iTerm2](https://www.iterm2.com), [Kitty](https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/), [Warp](https://www.warp.dev/), or terminals that support DRCS Sixel Graphics.

## Usage

Given the following JSON output:

```
{
    "mem": {
        "Heap": 1234,
        "Sys": 4321,
        "Stack": 203
    },
    "cpu": {
        "STime": 123,
        "UTime":1234
    },
    "Threads": 2
}
```

You can graph the number of thread over time:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars Threads
```

![](doc/single.png)

Or create a graph with both Utime and Stime growth rate on the same axis by using `+` between two field paths:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars counter:cpu.STime+counter:cpu.UTime
```

Note: the `counter:` prefix instructs jplot to compute the difference between the values instead of showing their absolute value.

![](doc/dual.png)


Or create several graphs by providing groups of fields as separate arguments; each argument creates a new graph:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars mem.Heap+mem.Sys+mem.Stack counter:cpu.STime+cpu.UTime Threads
```

![](doc/all.png)

### Spec Syntax

Each positional arguments given to jplot create a stacked graph with the specified values. To reference the values, use JSON query syntax. Several value paths can be referenced for the same graph by using the `+` character to separate them.

In addition, each value path can be prefixed with options separated from the path by a column. Several options can be used for the same command by separating them with a comma like so: `option1,option2:value.path`.

Supported options are:
* `counter`: Computes the difference with the last value. The value must increase monotonically.
* `marker`: When the value is none-zero, a vertical line is drawn.

## Recipes

### Memstats

Here is an example command to graph a Go program memstats:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars \
    memstats.HeapSys+memstats.HeapAlloc+memstats.HeapIdle+marker,counter:memstats.NumGC \
    counter:memstats.TotalAlloc \
    memstats.HeapObjects \
    memstats.StackSys+memstats.StackInuse
```

![](doc/memstats.png)

### Vegeta

With the help of jaggr, jplot can be used to integrate vegeta as follow:

```
echo 'GET http://localhost:8080' | \
    vegeta attack -rate 5000 -workers 100 -duration 10m | vegeta dump | \
    jaggr @count=rps \
          hist\[100,200,300,400,500\]:code \
          p25,p50,p95:latency \
          sum:bytes_in \
          sum:bytes_out | \
    jplot rps+code.hist.100+code.hist.200+code.hist.300+code.hist.400+code.hist.500 \
          latency.p95+latency.p50+latency.p25 \
          bytes_in.sum+bytes_out.sum
```

![](doc/vegeta.gif)

### Supported Terminals

* [xterm](http://invisible-island.net/xterm/)
* [iTerm2](https://www.iterm2.com/) on OSX
* [Kitty](https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/) on Linux/macOS/Windows
* [Warp](https://www.warp.dev/) on Linux/macOS/Windows
* [mintty](https://mintty.github.io/) on UNIX OSs via SSH
* [mlterm](https://sourceforge.net/projects/mlterm/) on Linux and Windows
* [RLogin](http://nanno.dip.jp/softlib/man/rlogin/) on Windows
* [yaft](http://uobikiemukot.github.io/yaft/) on Linux console
* [yaft-android](https://github.com/uobikiemukot/yaft-android) on Android
* [Tanasinn](http://saitoha.github.io/tanasinn/) on Firefox/Thunderbird

import pty, os, sys, time, select

master, slave = pty.openpty()

# Set pty window size using ioctl TIOCSWINSZ
import fcntl, struct, termios
# rows=24, cols=80, xpixels=800, ypixels=600
winsz = struct.pack("HHHH", 24, 80, 800, 600)
fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, winsz)

env = os.environ.copy()
env["TERM_PROGRAM"] = "iTerm.app"

p = subprocess.Popen(["./executable", "Threads"], stdin=slave, stdout=slave, stderr=slave, env=env, close_fds=True)
os.close(slave)

# Write some JSON to master
time.sleep(0.1)
os.write(master, b"{\"Threads\": 10}\n")
time.sleep(0.1)
os.write(master, b"{\"Threads\": 20}\n")
time.sleep(0.1)

# Read output
output = b""
while True:
    r, _, _ = select.select([master], [], [], 0.5)
    if not r:
        break
    try:
        data = os.read(master, 1024)
        if not data:
            break
        output += data
    except OSError:
        break

p.kill()
os.close(master)

print("PTY OUTPUT LEN:", len(output))
print("PTY OUTPUT REPR:", repr(output[:500]))
'"}

import pty, os, sys, time, select, subprocess, fcntl, struct, termios

def test_pty(env_dict={}, stdin_response=b""):
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    winsz = struct.pack("HHHH", 24, 80, 800, 600)
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, winsz)

    env = os.environ.copy()
    env.update(env_dict)

    p = subprocess.Popen(["./executable", "Threads"], stdin=slave, stdout=slave, stderr=slave, env=env, close_fds=True)
    os.close(slave)

    output = b""
    start = time.time()
    sent_resp = False
    while time.time() - start < 1.0:
        r, _, _ = select.select([master], [], [], 0.05)
        if r:
            try:
                data = os.read(master, 1024)
                if not data:
                    break
                output += data
                if b"\x1b[c" in output and not sent_resp and stdin_response:
                    os.write(master, stdin_response)
                    sent_resp = True
            except OSError:
                break

    try:
        p.terminate()
        p.wait(timeout=0.2)
    except:
        p.kill()
    os.close(master)
    print(f"ENV: {env_dict}, STDIN_RESP: {stdin_response}")

    p.terminate()
    p.wait(timeout=0.2)
except:

os.close(master)

print("TOTAL OUT LEN:", len(out))

{"command":"python3 -c '
import pty, os, sys, time, select, fcntl, struct, termios

def run_jplot(spec, json_inputs, env_extra={}):
    r_pipe, w_pipe = os.pipe()

    pid, fd = pty.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.close(w_pipe)
        os.dup2(r_pipe, 0)
        os.close(r_pipe)

        winsz = struct.pack("HHHH", 24, 80, 800, 600)
        fcntl.ioctl(1, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, winsz)
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env["TERM_PROGRAM"] = "iTerm.app"
        env.update(env_extra)
        os.execv("./executable", ["./executable"] + (spec if isinstance(spec, list) else [spec]))
    else:
        os.close(r_pipe)
        for json_line in json_inputs:
            os.write(w_pipe, json_line.encode("utf-8") + b"\n")
            time.sleep(0.05)

        out = b""
        start = time.time()
        while time.time() - start < 1.0:
            r, _, _ = select.select([fd], [], [], 0.05)
            if r:
                try:
                    data = os.read(fd, 4096)
                    if not data: break
                    out += data
                    if b"ReportCellSize" in data:
                        os.write(fd, b"\x1b]1337;ReportCellSize=18.00;8.00\x07")
                except OSError:
                    break

        os.close(w_pipe)
        try:
            os.kill(pid, 9)
            os.waitpid(pid, 0)
        except:
            pass
        os.close(fd)
        return out

out1 = run_jplot("counter:a", ["{\"a\": 10}", "{\"a\": 15}", "{\"a\": 20}"])
print("Counter inc len:", len(out1))
out2 = run_jplot("counter:a", ["{\"a\": 10}", "{\"a\": 5}"])
print("Counter dec len:", len(out2))
print("Counter dec repr:", repr(out2))
'"}

        os.close(r_pipe)

import base64, pty, os, sys, time, select, fcntl, struct, termios, re

def render_and_save(filename, args, json_inputs, rows=24, cols=80, xpixels=800, ypixels=600):
    r_pipe, w_pipe = os.pipe()

    pid, fd = pty.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.close(w_pipe)
        os.dup2(r_pipe, 0)
        os.close(r_pipe)

        winsz = struct.pack("HHHH", rows, cols, xpixels, ypixels)
        fcntl.ioctl(1, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, winsz)
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env["TERM_PROGRAM"] = "iTerm.app"
        os.execv("./executable", ["./executable"] + args)
    else:
        os.close(r_pipe)

        out = b""
        start = time.time()
        json_idx = 0

        while time.time() - start < 2.0:
            r, _, _ = select.select([fd], [], [], 0.05)
            if r:
                try:
                    data = os.read(fd, 4096)
                    if not data: break
                    out += data
                    if b"\x1b_G" in data:
                        os.write(fd, b"\x1b_Gi=1;OK\x1b\\")
                    if b"\x1b[c" in data:
                        os.write(fd, b"\x1b[?62;4c")
                    if b"\x1b[14t" in data:
                        os.write(fd, f"\x1b[4;{ypixels};{xpixels}t".encode())

                    while json_idx < len(json_inputs):
                        os.write(w_pipe, json_inputs[json_idx].encode() + b"\n")
                        json_idx += 1
                        time.sleep(0.02)
                except OSError:
                    break

        os.close(w_pipe)
        try:
            os.kill(pid, 9)
            os.waitpid(pid, 0)
        except: pass
        os.close(fd)

        # Extract last Kitty PNG
        m = re.findall(b";(iVBORw0KGgo[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)", out)
        if m:
            b64 = re.sub(b"[^A-Za-z0-9+/=]", b"", m[-1])
            mod = len(b64) % 4
            if mod != 0: b64 += b"=" * (4 - mod)
            png_bytes = base64.b64decode(b64)
            with open(filename, "wb") as f:
                f.write(png_bytes)
            print(f"Saved {filename} ({len(png_bytes)} bytes)")
            return png_bytes
        else:
            print(f"Failed to extract PNG for {filename}")
            return None

render_and_save("test_single.png", ["Threads"], ["{\"Threads\": 10}", "{\"Threads\": 20}", "{\"Threads\": 15}"])
render_and_save("test_multi_series.png", ["a+b+c"], ["{\"a\": 10, \"b\": 20, \"c\": 30}"])
render_and_save("test_multi_graph.png", ["a", "b", "c"], ["{\"a\": 10, \"b\": 20, \"c\": 30}"])
'"}

import zlib, struct

def parse_png(filename):
    with open(filename, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    assert data[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n", "Not a PNG file"

    idx = 8
    width = height = 0
    idat = b""

    while idx < len(data):
        length, chunk_type = struct.unpack(">I4s", data[idx:idx+8])
        idx += 8
        chunk_data = data[idx:idx+length]
        idx += length + 4 # skip CRC

        if chunk_type == b"IHDR":
            width, height, bit_depth, color_type, compression, filter_method, interlace = struct.unpack(">IIBBBBB", chunk_data)
            print(f"{filename}: IHDR size={width}x{height}, bit_depth={bit_depth}, color_type={color_type}")
        elif chunk_type == b"IDAT":
            idat += chunk_data

    decompressed = zlib.decompress(idat)
    # color_type 6 = RGBA (4 bytes per pixel)
    bpp = 4
    stride = width * bpp + 1 # 1 filter byte per scanline
    pixels = []

    # Unfilter scanlines
    prev_line = bytearray(width * bpp)
    raw_pixels = bytearray(height * width * bpp)

    for y in range(height):
        line = decompressed[y * stride : (y + 1) * stride]
        filter_type = line[0]
        scanline = bytearray(line[1:])

        if filter_type == 0: # None
            pass
        elif filter_type == 1: # Sub
            for x in range(bpp, width * bpp):
                scanline[x] = (scanline[x] + scanline[x - bpp]) & 0xFF
        elif filter_type == 2: # Up
            for x in range(width * bpp):
                scanline[x] = (scanline[x] + prev_line[x]) & 0xFF
        elif filter_type == 3: # Average
            for x in range(width * bpp):
                left = scanline[x - bpp] if x >= bpp else 0
                scanline[x] = (scanline[x] + ((left + prev_line[x]) // 2)) & 0xFF
        elif filter_type == 4: # Paeth
            for x in range(width * bpp):
                a = scanline[x - bpp] if x >= bpp else 0
                b = prev_line[x]
                c = prev_line[x - bpp] if x >= bpp else 0
                p = a + b - c
                pa, pb, pc = abs(p - a), abs(p - b), abs(p - c)
                pr = a if pa <= pb and pa <= pc else (b if pb <= pc else c)
                scanline[x] = (scanline[x] + pr) & 0xFF

        prev_line = scanline
        raw_pixels[y * width * bpp : (y + 1) * width * bpp] = scanline

    # Collect unique colors
    color_set = set()
    for i in range(0, len(raw_pixels), 4):
        color_set.add((raw_pixels[i], raw_pixels[i+1], raw_pixels[i+2], raw_pixels[i+3]))

    print(f"Unique colors count in {filename}: {len(color_set)}")
    # Find background color (top-left pixel)
    bg = (raw_pixels[0], raw_pixels[1], raw_pixels[2], raw_pixels[3])
    print(f"Top-left (background) color: RGBA{bg}")

parse_png("test_single.png")
parse_png("test_multi_series.png")
parse_png("test_multi_graph.png")

    with open(filename, "rb") as f:

    idx = 8
    width = height = 0
    idat = b""

    while idx < len(data):
        length, chunk_type = struct.unpack(">I4s", data[idx:idx+8])
        idx += 8
        chunk_data = data[idx:idx+length]
        idx += length + 4 # skip CRC

        if chunk_type == b"IHDR":
            width, height, bit_depth, color_type, compression, filter_method, interlace = struct.unpack(">IIBBBBB", chunk_data)
            print(f"{filename}: IHDR size={width}x{height}, bit_depth={bit_depth}, color_type={color_type}")
        elif chunk_type == b"IDAT":
            idat += chunk_data

    decompressed = zlib.decompress(idat)
    # color_type 6 = RGBA (4 bytes per pixel)
    bpp = 4
    stride = width * bpp + 1 # 1 filter byte per scanline
    pixels = []

    # Unfilter scanlines
    prev_line = bytearray(width * bpp)
    raw_pixels = bytearray(height * width * bpp)

    for y in range(height):
        line = decompressed[y * stride : (y + 1) * stride]
        filter_type = line[0]
        scanline = bytearray(line[1:])

        if filter_type == 0: # None
            pass
        elif filter_type == 1: # Sub
            for x in range(bpp, width * bpp):
                scanline[x] = (scanline[x] + scanline[x - bpp]) & 0xFF
        elif filter_type == 2: # Up
            for x in range(width * bpp):
                scanline[x] = (scanline[x] + prev_line[x]) & 0xFF
        elif filter_type == 3: # Average
            for x in range(width * bpp):
                left = scanline[x - bpp] if x >= bpp else 0
                scanline[x] = (scanline[x] + ((left + prev_line[x]) // 2)) & 0xFF
        elif filter_type == 4: # Paeth
            for x in range(width * bpp):
                a = scanline[x - bpp] if x >= bpp else 0
                b = prev_line[x]
                c = prev_line[x - bpp] if x >= bpp else 0
                p = a + b - c
                pa, pb, pc = abs(p - a), abs(p - b), abs(p - c)
                pr = a if pa <= pb and pa <= pc else (b if pb <= pc else c)
                scanline[x] = (scanline[x] + pr) & 0xFF

        prev_line = scanline
        raw_pixels[y * width * bpp : (y + 1) * width * bpp] = scanline

    # Collect unique colors
    color_set = set()
    for i in range(0, len(raw_pixels), 4):
        color_set.add((raw_pixels[i], raw_pixels[i+1], raw_pixels[i+2], raw_pixels[i+3]))

    print(f"Unique colors count in {filename}: {len(color_set)}")
    # Find background color (top-left pixel)
    bg = (raw_pixels[0], raw_pixels[1], raw_pixels[2], raw_pixels[3])
    print(f"Top-left (background) color: RGBA{bg}")

import base64, pty, os, sys, time, select, fcntl, struct, termios, re

def render_and_save(filename, args, json_inputs, rows=24, cols=80, xpixels=800, ypixels=600):
    r_pipe, w_pipe = os.pipe()

    pid, fd = pty.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.close(w_pipe)
        os.dup2(r_pipe, 0)
        os.close(r_pipe)

        winsz = struct.pack("HHHH", rows, cols, xpixels, ypixels)
        fcntl.ioctl(1, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, winsz)
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env["TERM_PROGRAM"] = "iTerm.app"
        os.execv("./executable", ["./executable"] + args)
    else:
        os.close(r_pipe)

        out = b""
        start = time.time()
        json_idx = 0

        while time.time() - start < 2.0:
            r, _, _ = select.select([fd], [], [], 0.05)
            if r:
                try:
                    data = os.read(fd, 4096)
                    if not data: break
                    out += data
                    if b"\x1b_G" in data:
                        os.write(fd, b"\x1b_Gi=1;OK\x1b\\")
                    if b"\x1b[c" in data:
                        os.write(fd, b"\x1b[?62;4c")
                    if b"\x1b[14t" in data:
                        os.write(fd, f"\x1b[4;{ypixels};{xpixels}t".encode())

                    while json_idx < len(json_inputs):
                        os.write(w_pipe, json_inputs[json_idx].encode() + b"\n")
                        json_idx += 1
                        time.sleep(0.02)
                except OSError:
                    break

        os.close(w_pipe)
        try:
            os.kill(pid, 9)
            os.waitpid(pid, 0)
        except: pass
        os.close(fd)

        # Extract Kitty PNG: payload between ; and \x1b\\
        start_pos = out.rfind(b"\x1b_Ga=T,f=100,t=d,i=2,X=0,Y=0,q=2;")
        if start_pos != -1:
            start_pos += len(b"\x1b_Ga=T,f=100,t=d,i=2,X=0,Y=0,q=2;")
            end_pos = out.find(b"\x1b\\", start_pos)
            b64 = out[start_pos:end_pos]

            return png_bytes
        else:
            print(f"Failed to extract PNG for {filename}")
            return None

import pty, os, sys, time, select, fcntl, struct, termios

r_pipe, w_pipe = os.pipe()

pid, fd = pty.fork()
if pid == 0:
    os.close(w_pipe)
    os.dup2(r_pipe, 0)
    os.close(r_pipe)

    winsz = struct.pack("HHHH", 24, 80, 800, 600)
    fcntl.ioctl(1, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, winsz)
    os.execv("./executable", ["./executable", "Threads"])
else:
    os.close(r_pipe)

    out = b""
    start = time.time()
    sent_json = False

    while time.time() - start < 1.0:
        r, _, _ = select.select([fd], [], [], 0.05)
        if r:
            try:
                data = os.read(fd, 4096)
                if not data: break
                out += data
                print(f"[{time.time()-start:.3f}s] GOT:", repr(data[:100]))
                if b"\x1b_G" in data:
                    os.write(fd, b"\x1b_Gi=1;OK\x1b\\")
                if b"\x1b[c" in data:
                    os.write(fd, b"\x1b[?62;4c")
                if b"\x1b[14t" in data:
                    os.write(fd, b"\x1b[4;600;800t")
                    if not sent_json:
                        os.write(w_pipe, b"{\"Threads\": 42}\n")
                        sent_json = True
            except OSError:
                break

    os.close(w_pipe)
    try:
        os.kill(pid, 9)
        os.waitpid(pid, 0)
    except: pass
    os.close(fd)

    print("TOTAL OUT LEN:", len(out))
'"}

r_pipe, w_pipe = os.pipe()

pid, fd = pty.fork()
if pid == 0:
    os.close(w_pipe)
    os.dup2(r_pipe, 0)
    os.close(r_pipe)

    winsz = struct.pack("HHHH", 24, 80, 800, 600)
    fcntl.ioctl(1, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, winsz)

    os.close(r_pipe)

    start = time.time()
    sent_json = False

    while time.time() - start < 2.5:
        r, _, _ = select.select([fd], [], [], 0.05)
        if r:
            try:
                data = os.read(fd, 4096)
                if not data: break
                out += data
                if b"\x1b_G" in data:
                    os.write(fd, b"\x1b_Gi=1;OK\x1b\\")
                if b"\x1b[c" in data:
                    os.write(fd, b"\x1b[?62;4c")

    try:
        os.kill(pid, 9)
        os.waitpid(pid, 0)
    except: pass
    os.close(fd)

        pos = out.find(b"\x1b_G", pos)
        if pos == -1: break
        st = out.find(b"\x1b\\", pos)

        chunk = out[pos:st]
        pos = st + 2
        semi = chunk.find(b";")

            b64_payload = chunk[semi+1:]
            b64_clean = re.sub(b"[^A-Za-z0-9+/=]", b"", b64_payload)
            mod = len(b64_clean) % 4
            if mod != 0: b64_clean += b"=" * (4 - mod)

                print("Header:", header)
                print("Decoded PNG len:", len(png), "Header:", png[:8])

            except Exception as e:
                print("Decode error:", e)

{"command":"python3 -c '
import zlib, struct

def parse_png(filename):
    with open(filename, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    assert data[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n", "Not a PNG file"

    idx = 8
    width = height = 0
    idat = b""

    while idx < len(data):
        length, chunk_type = struct.unpack(">I4s", data[idx:idx+8])
        idx += 8
        chunk_data = data[idx:idx+length]
        idx += length + 4 # skip CRC

        if chunk_type == b"IHDR":
            width, height, bit_depth, color_type, compression, filter_method, interlace = struct.unpack(">IIBBBBB", chunk_data)
            print(f"{filename}: IHDR size={width}x{height}, bit_depth={bit_depth}, color_type={color_type}")
        elif chunk_type == b"IDAT":
            idat += chunk_data

    decompressed = zlib.decompress(idat)
    bpp = 4
    stride = width * bpp + 1
    prev_line = bytearray(width * bpp)
    raw_pixels = bytearray(height * width * bpp)

    for y in range(height):
        line = decompressed[y * stride : (y + 1) * stride]
        filter_type = line[0]
        scanline = bytearray(line[1:])

        if filter_type == 0: pass
        elif filter_type == 1:
            for x in range(bpp, width * bpp):
                scanline[x] = (scanline[x] + scanline[x - bpp]) & 0xFF
        elif filter_type == 2:
            for x in range(width * bpp):
                scanline[x] = (scanline[x] + prev_line[x]) & 0xFF
        elif filter_type == 3:
            for x in range(width * bpp):
                left = scanline[x - bpp] if x >= bpp else 0
                scanline[x] = (scanline[x] + ((left + prev_line[x]) // 2)) & 0xFF
        elif filter_type == 4:
            for x in range(width * bpp):
                a = scanline[x - bpp] if x >= bpp else 0
                b = prev_line[x]
                c = prev_line[x - bpp] if x >= bpp else 0
                p = a + b - c
                pa, pb, pc = abs(p - a), abs(p - b), abs(p - c)
                pr = a if pa <= pb and pa <= pc else (b if pb <= pc else c)
                scanline[x] = (scanline[x] + pr) & 0xFF

        prev_line = scanline
        raw_pixels[y * width * bpp : (y + 1) * width * bpp] = scanline

    color_counts = {}
    for i in range(0, len(raw_pixels), 4):
        c = (raw_pixels[i], raw_pixels[i+1], raw_pixels[i+2], raw_pixels[i+3])
        color_counts[c] = color_counts.get(c, 0) + 1

    print(f"Top 15 most common colors in {filename}:")
    sorted_colors = sorted(color_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    for col, count in sorted_colors[:15]:
        print(f"  RGBA{col}: {count} pixels ({count / (width*height) * 100:.2f}%)")

parse_png("single_frame.png")
'"}

        prev_line = bytearray(w * bpp)

            filter_type = line[0]
            scanline = bytearray(line[1:])

            elif filter_type == 1:

            raw_pixels[y * w * bpp : (y + 1) * w * bpp] = scanline

                for x in range(w * bpp):

                    scanline[x] = (scanline[x] + ((left + prev_line[x]) // 2)) & 0xFF

                if b"a=q" in header: continue

            idx += 8
            if ctype == b"IHDR":
                w, h = struct.unpack(">II", png[idx:idx+8])
            elif ctype == b"IDAT":

            filter_type = line[0]
            scanline = bytearray(line[1:])

            if filter_type == 0: pass
            elif filter_type == 1:
                for x in range(bpp, w * bpp):

            elif filter_type == 2:
                for x in range(w * bpp):

            elif filter_type == 3:
                for x in range(w * bpp):

                    scanline[x] = (scanline[x] + ((left + prev_line[x]) // 2)) & 0xFF

                    pa, pb, pc = abs(p - a), abs(p - b), abs(p - c)
                    pr = a if pa <= pb and pa <= pc else (b if pb <= pc else c)
                    scanline[x] = (scanline[x] + pr) & 0xFF

            prev_line = scanline
            raw_pixels[y * w * bpp : (y + 1) * w * bpp] = scanline

        return w, h, raw_pixels

import subprocess, os

def compare_run(args, stdin_data="", env_extra={}):
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env.update(env_extra)

    p_orig = subprocess.run(["./executable"] + args, input=stdin_data, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)

import pty, os, sys, time, select, fcntl, struct, termios

r_pipe, w_pipe = os.pipe()

pid, fd = pty.fork()
if pid == 0:
    os.close(w_pipe)
    os.dup2(r_pipe, 0)
    os.close(r_pipe)

    attrs = termios.tcgetattr(1)
    attrs[3] &= ~termios.ECHO
    termios.tcsetattr(1, termios.TCSANOW, attrs)

    winsz = struct.pack("HHHH", 24, 80, 800, 600)
    fcntl.ioctl(1, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, winsz)
    os.execv("./executable", ["./executable", "Threads"])
else:
    os.close(r_pipe)

    out = b""
    start = time.time()
    sent_json = False

    while time.time() - start < 2.0:
        r, _, _ = select.select([fd], [], [], 0.05)
        if r:
            try:
                data = os.read(fd, 4096)
                if not data: break
                out += data
                if b"\x1b_G" in data:
                    os.write(fd, b"\x1b_Gi=1;ENOENT\x1b\\")
                if b"\x1b[c" in data:
                    os.write(fd, b"\x1b[?63;1;2;3;4;22c")
                if b"\x1b[14t" in data:
                    os.write(fd, b"\x1b[4;600;800t")
                    if not sent_json:
                        time.sleep(0.05)
                        os.write(w_pipe, b"{\"Threads\": 42}\n")
                        sent_json = True
            except OSError:
                break

    os.close(w_pipe)
    try:
        os.kill(pid, 9)
        os.waitpid(pid, 0)
    except: pass
    os.close(fd)

    sixel_start = out.find(b"\x1bP")
    sixel_end = out.find(b"\x1b\\", sixel_start)
    sixel_seq = out[sixel_start:sixel_end+2] if sixel_start != -1 else b""
    print("Sixel Seq Len:", len(sixel_seq))
    print("Sixel Header:", repr(sixel_seq[:100]))
    print("Sixel Tail:", repr(sixel_seq[-50:]))
'"}
